_doc: Keys integrated through a customer-side proxy URL. 'skip' lists the CDN-level fields that describe the customer's proxy, not the visitor: ja4 (TLS/JA4 checks, UA vs JA4), http_version (HTTP/3 / HTTP/1.1 checks), header_order (cdn-header-order-* / susp-rfc-violation-* header flags - do not draft TTs on them). Judge these keys on client-side fingerprint fields. Verified per key from one day of JA4 / HTTP-version profile (2026-11-24).
